{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for internal QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')

# Check the distribution of channels and customer_segment
df_grouped = df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print('\nChannel and segment distribution:\n', df_grouped)

# Check the distribution of 'converted' by channel
df_conv = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print('\nConversion rate by channel (raw):\n', df_conv)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f'Number of customer_age == -1: {df[df["customer_age"] == -1].shape[0]}')"}
